text:
bench-bot: ProbeBench finished for Mistral-7B + Llama2-7B across us-west-2 / eu-west-1 / ap-northeast-1. variants: fp16, q4_0, q8_0. Kernels: fast-attn / fallback. Short summary below.

maya: dropping raw numbers. small table (median prefill / median decode / tokens/sec / $/1M tokens)
```
model, gpu, region, prefill_ms, decode_ms, tokens_per_sec, dollars_per_1M
Mistral-7B, H100, us-west-2, 36, 12, 6800, 17.8
Mistral-7B, A100, us-west-2, 52, 16, 4800, 22.6
Mistral-7B, H100, eu-west-1, 40, 14, 6400, 18.9
Mistral-7B, A100, eu-west-1, 58, 18, 4600, 23.4
Llama2-7B, H100, ap-northeast-1, 44, 15, 6100, 19.6
Llama2-7B, A100, ap-northeast-1, 63, 20, 4200, 25.1
```

jason: quick notes — prefill is where H100 wins hard (KV+prefill fused kernels). decode gap is smaller but still measurable. overall tokens/sec delta ~1.3-1.6x favoring H100 depending on region.

anita: observed kernel fallbacks in ap-northeast for q4_0 on A100 (thermal throttling + non-optimal kernel selected). p95/p99 spikes — saw decode p99 up to ~420ms in a few runs.

denver: any config we used for kernel selection? share the command so infra can reproduce.

maya: repro command we ran: 
```bash
./probebench run --model {mistral-7b,llama2-7b} --gpus {A100,H100} --regions us-west-2,eu-west-1,ap-northeast-1 \
  --quant q4_0,q8_0,fp16 --kernels fast-attn,fallback --qps 50 --duration 300 --seed 42
```

maya: also toggled kernel heuristic on/off: heuristic prefers fast-attn when seq_len < 1024 and batch < 8. disabling it forces fallback and reproduces A100 slow path.

jason: cost calc details: used cloud SKU hourly + observed tokens/sec. numbers above include an ops overhead multiplier of 1.08 for networking and scheduling.

anita: recommendation: for Mistral-7B default to H100 in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for now, enable q8_0 for latency-sensitive traffic in A100 to shrink gap. For ap-northeast, add thermal-margin autoscaling (lower rack temp) or prefer H100.

bench-bot: flags: reproducible run id 2026-03-19T14:32Z id=pb-3499001234. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/probebench/pb-3499001234/{metrics,profiles,raw-logs}.zip

sre-bot: noted an elevated gpu temp event during run 4 on a100-ap-northeast-1-2; linked in artifacts.

denver: product note — $/1M tokens diff is meaningful for committed capacity pricing. If teams expect 1B tokens/month, delta ~ $4-6k/mo per model for A100 vs H100. good to surface in onboarding docs.

maya: next steps: 1) push kernel-heuristic tweak to staging (maya -> jason), 2) add region-specific policy to model catalog (denver to own UX), 3) re-run narrow q8_0-only sweep for apac to validate.

jason: I'll own the kernel tweak. pushing a small opt to prefer fused-kernel on a100 when mem bandwidth high.

anita: I'll open infra ticket for thermal margin + capacity bump in ap-northeast.

denver: i'll add a short blurb to the model onboarding checklist noting H100 preferred for low-latency prefill workloads.

maya: thanks all — attaching a tiny flame graph snippet in artifacts for the Mistral fp16 H100 decode path if you want to eyeball hotspots.

bench-bot: thread closed after actions created (3 tasks).
